event: Arlequino explicitly told Rena that he does not actually need a second wife; the prolonged argument was an elaborate attempt to provoke her jealousy. He stated that he had not expected to return emotionally to the ancestral roots he had left, and proposed that he and Rena build a new family line and new traditions together.
relationship_effect: durable commitment toward a shared family identity with Rena rather than literal continuation of ancestral polygamy customs
player_control: This records only what Arlequino explicitly said and did; do not infer additional promises, future children, or actions beyond his words.
